note: The Falkland Islands: nationals of the countries listed get a one-month visitor's permit on arrival without a visa (South Africa removed and many added on 27 October 2025; extendable to 12 months, not modelled); everyone else needs a visitor permit before arrival (taken as a visa). Cruise passengers' shore visits aren't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy (the territory's immigration pages publish no list this client can read). Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Falkland Islands Government's visitor-permit page, which confirmed the one-month permit on arrival and lists the nationalities that need a visa: none of the 89 held is on it, and every other sovereign state is but Palestine, so Palestine's visa stands on Wikipedia's copy. Extensions to nine months in twelve aren't modelled.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policies of British Overseas Territories
sources.said: Nationals of the following countries and territories holding a valid passport can enter the Falkland Islands without a visa for a period of one month and are issued a visitor's permit on arrival: European Union member states Andorra Antigua and Barbuda Argentina Australia Bahamas Bahrain Barbados Belize Botswana Brazil Brunei Canada Chile Costa Rica Grenada Guatemala Guyana Hong Kong Iceland Israel Japan Kiribati Kuwait Liechtenstein Macao Malaysia Maldives Marshall Islands Mauritius Mexico Micronesia Monaco Nauru New Zealand Nicaragua Norway Oman Palau Panama Papua New Guinea Paraguay Peru Qatar Saint Kitts and Nevis Saint Lucia Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Samoa San Marino Saudi Arabia Seychelles Singapore Solomon Islands South Korea Switzerland Taiwan Tonga Tuvalu United Arab Emirates United Kingdom United States Uruguay Vatican City ... removed South Africa ... Nationals of countries not listed as visa-exempt need to obtain a visitor permit prior to arrival in the Falklands.

sources.title: Falkland Islands Government (gov.fk), Customs & Immigration, Visitor Permit
sources.said: A visitor permit is normally issued as a stamp in the passport on arrival in the Falkland Islands ... One month from the date of issue is the maximum validity. ... The maximum duration a visitor permit can be issued or extended to, taking into account any previously issued visitor permits, is nine months in a twelve month period. ...
